about.title: Built on experience. Driven by integrity.
text: For over 30 years, Joshua Dade Contractors has delivered safe, high-quality industrial construction and specialty services to clients across the Gulf Coast and beyond.

JDC was founded with a simple but powerful commitment: to provide commercial construction, maintenance and specialty services that clients can depend on, delivered safely, on schedule and to the highest standards of quality.

Over three decades, JDC has grown from a regional contractor into a full-service industrial firm with the manpower, equipment and expertise to handle the most complex projects in the energy, petrochemical and manufacturing sectors.

Our management team brings over 30 years of combined industry experience to every project. That depth of knowledge, paired with a culture built on safety, quality, integrity and performance, is what sets JDC apart and keeps our clients coming back.
about.imageAlt: Craft workers in hard hats and high-visibility gear on an industrial job site

values.title: Safety
values.text: Safety is the first priority on every project, every day, and every team member is held to the same standard.

values.title: Quality
values.text: Work that meets and exceeds client expectations, backed by ASME certifications and experienced craftsmen.

values.title: Integrity
values.text: We do what we say. Clients trust us because we are consistent in our estimates, our timelines and our work.

values.title: Performance
values.text: The right people, equipment and processes on every project, to deliver on time, on budget and to spec.

faqs.q: What kind of work does JDC take on?
faqs.a: Industrial construction, fire suppression, I&E and automation, ASME code fabrication, civil site development, commercial diving and technical field services, for government and private clients in the energy, petrochemical and manufacturing sectors.

We operate from three Gulf Coast locations: the main office and fabrication shop in Deer Park, and field offices in Mount Belvieu and Cypress, covering the Houston Ship Channel corridor, the Baytown and Chambers County area, northwest Houston and the wider Gulf Coast.

faqs.q: What can your fabrication shop handle?
faqs.a: The shop is 10,000 sq ft with 20-ton crane capacity, and we hold ASME U and R stamps along with API tank fabrication capability, for pressure vessels, tanks, structural steel, pipe, duct work and custom process equipment.

faqs.q: How quickly do you respond to a bid request?
faqs.a: We follow up on a bid request within one business day.

faqs.q: Can you run a turnaround with multiple crafts at once?
faqs.a: Yes. On a turnaround we run mechanical, piping, civil and I&E scopes at the same time across multiple units, to keep the outage as short as possible.

faqs.q: What safety credentials does JDC hold?
faqs.a: We are ISNetworld certified and Avetta approved, maintain a full OSHA safety program across every job site and facility, and every employee is empowered to stop work if something is not right.
